observations.code_quote: - [ ] `Opportunities (GET /rest/v1/opportunities.json)` — connect marketing activity with pipeline and revenue outcomes (high). Skipped: a lookup by key, not a list. The endpoint requires `filterType` + `filterValues`, the only searchable fields are `externalOpportunityId`, `marketoGUID` and custom string/integer fields, and Marketo documents no way to list every record and no `updatedAt` filter, so the collection can't be enumerated without already knowing every key.
